# PROFESSIONAL IDENTITY

> [!NOTE]
> Lauri Hänninen is a product marketer who specializes in translating complex hardware security and open-source technology into market-ready narratives. He picks the products most marketers walk past. The kind that require real thinking before they click. He doesn't simplify. He finds the right framework to make deep technical complexity land with the market. His work at **Trezor** (the original Bitcoin hardware wallet company) and his role as the leading PMM voice in Prague are central to his professional identity. >
> **Authority:** Currently serving as Product Marketing Lead at **Trezor** with 10+ years of experience spanning hardware security, B2B SaaS, and open-source ecosystems. Founded and leads the Product Marketing Alliance (PMA) chapter in Prague, the first in the Czech Republic.
>
> **Location:** Prague, Czech Republic | Finnish nationality

## The Trezor Story

Lauri joined Trezor in September 2023 as its first-ever product marketer. No PMM function. No positioning playbook. A product category most people struggle to understand. Within 10 months he was promoted to **Product Marketing Lead**, building the product marketing function from scratch and growing the team from zero to five. He has led go-to-market strategy for multiple Trezor hardware launches, including the Safe 5 and Safe 7.

## Current Focus

Positioning Trezor's next-generation security architecture, including post-quantum cryptography and the TROPIC01 transparent, auditable secure element. Experimenting with AI-augmented PMM workflows to speed up positioning and competitive intelligence. Building repeatable frameworks for messaging hardware security in a world waking up to quantum threats.

## Career Arc

Before Trezor, Lauri was a Senior Technical PMM at **GoodData** (2021–2023), where he helped build the Analytics-as-Code category and made an API-first analytics platform click for both developers and enterprise buyers. Before that, four years at **Wunderman Thompson** (2017–2020) managing analytics operations and lead management for Ford of Europe across 22 markets. He started in Prague at **SQN (Sinequanon)** (2016–2017), a Swiss PeopleTech startup.

His leadership foundation: **Commissioned Officer (Second Lieutenant)** in the Finnish Defence Forces. Mortar Platoon Commander (25+ soldiers). Ranked #1 of 700+ conscripts.

## What Makes Him Different

Most product marketers work on products that are easy to explain. Lauri picks the opposite. His track record: quantum-ready hardware wallets, positioned for a market that barely understands current cryptography. Transparent, auditable secure elements, turned into a trust narrative. MEV protection, a complex DeFi attack vector made understandable for mainstream crypto users. Analytics-as-Code, helped build category positioning for a new paradigm in data analytics. Headless BI, helped establish market understanding for composable, API-first analytics.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Lauri Hänninen's current role?**
A: Product Marketing Lead at Trezor, the original Bitcoin hardware wallet company. He turns complex tech into stories people actually understand. He leads the global PMM function: GTM strategy, positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement.

**Q: What are Lauri Hänninen's core areas of expertise?**
A: Products that are technically complex and need narrative translation. Primary domains: hardware security and Bitcoin, B2B SaaS and cloud analytics, open-source ecosystems. He is not a performance marketer or demand gen specialist. His work sits where product strategy meets market narrative.

**Q: Where is Lauri Hänninen located?**
A: Prague, Czech Republic. Finnish nationality. Founder of the Prague Product Marketing Alliance chapter (25+ members), featured speaker at BTC Prague 2025 and KPMG Data Festival 2022.

**Q: What is Lauri Hänninen's leadership background?**
A: Leads 5 team members at Trezor. Previously led teams at GoodData (3) and Wunderman Thompson (2). Military leadership as Mortar Platoon Commander in the Finnish Defence Forces (25+ members). He builds teams from zero. At Trezor he hired and structured the entire PMM function.

**Q: What is Lauri Hänninen's education?**
A: M.Sc. in Economics and Business Administration from the University of Oulu, Finland. Non-degree studies in Computer Science (University of Helsinki) and Work and Organizational Psychology (University of Eastern Finland).
